title: Rajasthan RSSB Forester Exam City / Admit Card 2026
intro: Short Information : Rajasthan Staff Selection Board (RSSB) has released the exam date for the recruitment of Forester (Vanpal) posts on the official website. This recruitment was released for 259 posts. Applications for the RSSB Forester (Vanpal) Recruitment 2026 were accepted from January 06, 2026, to February 11, 2026. The online examination is going to be conducted on 28 June 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can download their Rajasthan RSSB Forester Exam City / Admit Card 2026 from the link given below.
applicationFee: Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
